# AWS Chaos Engineering Framework 2.0.5

This release tightens live approval, AWS caller binding, recovery checks, report publication, and verification of release assets. Several operations are now planning-only when the AWS API cannot bind a change to the exact reviewed resource state. Review the current operation contract before upgrading any approved live workflow.

Plan mode remains the default. The project supports Python 3.12 through 3.14. The package description, runtime, and standalone asset agree on the release version.

The verified release contains the standalone runtime, wheel, normalized source archive, SPDX SBOM, SHA-256 checksums, and commit-bound release evidence.
